artworks.title: Plan et elevation des plus beaux confessionnaux de Paris, tres fidelemant mesure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural piece. The image shows a highly detailed and ornate structure with classical elements such as columns, a domed roof, and intricate carvings. The design includes decorative urns and sculptures. The central portion of the structure features a door with scrollwork, flanked by columns, and topped with a segmental pediment adorned with a winged cherub. The base of the structure is shown with a sectional view. The style and architectural precision suggest it could be a facade or a freestanding monument.

artworks.title: Plan et elevation des plus beaux confessionnaux de Paris, tres fidelemant mesure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure resembling an altar with a cross. The image features a tall, ornate structure with classical elements such as arches, columns, and intricate decorative features. The upper section includes a prominent cross at the apex, surrounded by a semicircular relief showcasing cherubic figures within a decorative arch. Below, a wide central arch frames a recessed space, flanked by decorative panels on either side. This drawing appears to be a detailed architectural plan showcasing both the front elevation and a cross-sectional view, complete with measurement scales.

artworks.title: Plan et elevation des plus beaux confessionnaux de Paris, tres fidelemant mesure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design. It shows a detailed architectural blueprint of a decorative facade element. The blueprint features ornate moldings, a pediment, elaborate scrollwork, symmetrical layout with rectangular and arch-shaped panels embellished with intricate patterns and ornamental details. Two urns are depicted atop the corners of the structure. The bottom section of the blueprint illustrates the foundation plan. The design suggests a neoclassical or baroque influence in its decorative style.

artworks.title: Plan et elevation des plus beaux confessionnaux de Paris, tres fidelemant mesure
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed architectural drawing of a section of a church pulpit. It features a domed top with sculpted ornamentation and a cross at its apex. The pulpit has detailed engravings, including winged angel faces on the dome. The structure has columns adorned with leaf motifs supporting a pediment. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of black. The style of the drawing is elaborate, with intricate detailing reflecting a baroque influence. The image is an elevation view.

artworks.title: Livre de Tables
artworks.description: The image shows a series of vessels, including urns with ornate handles and large pitchers, displayed on two decorated tables. The color palette is monochrome, with black etchings on a light beige background. The vessels are positioned on the tables, which feature elaborate, carved details and ornate patterns. Decorative elements such as cherubs and floral motifs are placed beneath the tabletops.

artworks.title: Livre de Tables
artworks.description: The image contains ornate panels with intricate designs and a decorative urn on a carved ledge above them. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia-toned shades and detailed shading. Several urns of varying sizes and designs are displayed along the top of the ledge, with relief patterns and decorative motifs on the panels below featuring symmetrical arrangements of scrolls and emblems.

artworks.title: Livre de Tables
artworks.description: The image shows two ornately designed tables covered with intricate floral and scrollwork patterns. Various decorative objects, including ewers, bowls, and serving vessels, some shaped like birds, are placed on top of the tables. The color palette consists of sepia tones and shades of beige. The left table holds smaller objects, while the right table displays larger vessels, with bird-shaped objects featured prominently. The tables have detailed carvings, with ornate figures at each corner.

artworks.title: Livre de Tables
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate table with intricate carvings and designs, featuring an array of decorative urns and vessels on top. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily consisting of sepia tones. An elaborate urn is positioned at the center of the surface, surrounded by various-sized vessels that extend symmetrically towards each end of the table. The table is decorated with floral and human motifs, with detailed carvings on the legs and sides.

artworks.title: Livre de Tables
artworks.description: The image shows two elaborately carved console tables adorned with intricate patterns and ornamental figures, topped with decorative vessels such as urns, jugs, and bowls. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of black and white. The objects on the tables are centered, with larger vessels placed centrally or near the top and smaller items dispersed around them. The tables themselves occupy the lower portion of the image, one on the left with elaborate decorations including a medallion and a vase beneath, and the other on the right with a figure holding a basket of flowers depicted underneath.

artworks.title: Livre de Tables
artworks.description: The image displays two elaborately carved tables with intricate detailing. On top of the tables are ornate vessels, including urns, cups, and pitchers with detailed engravings and designs. The color palette is primarily shades of beige and dark brown. The prominent table on the right is longer with a lion-faced motif at its center and decorative side flourishes. Adjacent is a smaller table with a similar motif and intricate carvings. The image is bordered on the far left and right sides.

artworks.title: Prairie Titlark
artworks.artist: Robert Havell, Jr. after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on J. Whatman paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird perched on a rock surrounded by pink flowers and grass. The bird is depicted with brown plumage, a speckled chest, and a slender tail, standing upon the rocks. Surrounding the rock are delicate pink flowers and green blades of grass. The background is left blank. The text at the bottom indicates that this is identified as a Prairie Titlark, scientifically named Anthus Pipens. The work is intended to display the bird in a manner characteristic of naturalist documentation.

artworks.title: Grain Field at the Edge of a Wood (Corn Field)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an open field, a line of trees, and clouds in the sky. It uses a fine etching or engraving technique with detailed line work, capturing the textures of the grassy fields and trees. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on tan paper. Detailed grass and brushwork is visible in the foreground, with a dense cluster of trees further back. The sky features cloud formations suggested through dynamic lines and curves.

artworks.title: Le haut d'un battant de porte (Birds Nailed to a Barn Door)
artworks.description: The image features three birds and a bat arranged on a wooden surface. A crow with outstretched wings is on the left, an owl with wide-spread wings on the right, and a smaller hawk with folded wings at the center bottom. Above the hawk is a bat with extended wings. The colors in the image are primarily grayscale. The wooden surface has vertical planks, and a metal hinge detail is visible on the right side.

artworks.title: David and Bathsheba
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an allegorical scene. The composition includes architectural elements in the background such as a castle-like structure and trees. Foreground figures are engaged in various actions: one figure offers something on a tray to another seated figure, while a third plays a harp, accompanied by a bird. The artwork features intricate lines and cross-hatching, typical of Renaissance iconography, aiming to convey a narrative or symbolic theme.

artworks.title: Apple Trees in Auvers (Pommiers a Auvers)
artworks.description: The image depicts an open landscape with a high horizon line where the sky meets a line of distant trees. The artist uses fine lines to create texture and depth across the scene. The etching shows a contrast between detailed lines for foliage and horizontal strokes for the sky. The color palette is monochrome with dark lines on a light background. A path winds through the landscape with trees in small clusters and a figure walking along it. Distant trees are softer and less defined, adding depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: The Infant in the Gallery
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with classical elements. The image features a circular composition depicting a grand architectural structure reminiscent of ancient Roman or Greek design. The scene includes rows of ornate columns with intricate capitals supporting an entablature adorned with decorative motifs. The perspective leads the eye into the background, revealing additional classical buildings and structures. On the floor, there is a sculptural figure, possibly representing a mythological character, seated among scattered architectural pieces, including sections resembling broken columns. The lines and patterns emphasize depth, showcasing architectural rendering and attention to detail. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: The Big Cedar
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A large tree dominates the right side of the image, with branches extending outward. A fence is in the foreground. A line of distant trees marks the horizon in the middle of the image. Beyond the tree and fence, a horse-drawn cart loaded with hay and a small farm building are visible. The artwork features fine and detailed brushwork capturing textures. The color palette is monochrome sepia.

artworks.title: The Broad Curtain
artworks.description: The image shows a part of a person's body in a cushioned chair, engrossed in a book or magazine. The person sits in a relaxed position, with dark hair and light-colored clothing. A table with a tall plant and a decorative object is beside them. The background includes large windows with sheer curtains, a wall, and a hanging picture frame.

artworks.title: Saint George on Horseback Slaying the Dragon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.6 x 15.4 cm (8 7/8 x 6 1/16 in.)

artworks.title: Deer Hunt (La chasse au cerf)
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a dark, wooded area under a transitioning sky. Trees create a low skyline. The lithograph technique produces fine brushstrokes for a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and grey creating contrasts and forms in the scene. There are faint animal forms, possibly horses, in the distance.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image is a landscape drawing showing rugged mountains with a castle on cliffs, a winding river, detailed trees, a bridge with people crossing it, and a monochromatic color palette of varying brown shades.

artworks.title: David and Goliath
artworks.medium: etching//conjoining subject on 2 sheets of paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures on a battlefield. In the foreground, an armored figure stands with a spear and shield, looking left. To the right, a smaller figure holds a sling. In the background, there is a hillside with buildings and tents, and lines suggesting the sun.

artworks.title: Seated Magician with Other Figures beside an Altar
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a natural setting. The central figure is seated, with a full beard and hair covered by a cloth. He wears a tunic with ornamentation and a cloak. Next to him stands a second man, shirtless and holding a staff. There are objects around them - a large vase, an owl, and a cow skull. The background shows outdoor scenery with bare trees. The ground is uneven.

artworks.title: Saint Peter Walking on the Water
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a ship and figures interacting on a turbulent sea. The drawing shows two figures in the foreground surrounded by waves. One figure is leaning toward the other, pointing emphatically while holding the other's hand. In the background, a ship with an intricately designed hull and sails is seen, with several figures aboard. The waves are depicted with energetic and swirling lines. The sky has stylized clouds. The drawing also features detailed lines and shading.
